changelogs: - Fixed the resource refusing to start on servers that already had a garage column, with 'Data truncated for column garage at row 2' in the console. The boot migration adds the columns msk_garage needs and then tightens garage to varchar(60) NOT NULL. On a fresh database that works, but if the column already existed, from msk_garage v3 or another garage script, the first step skips it and leaves its old definition alone, so it still allows NULL and is sometimes wider than 60 characters. Tightening it afterwards then fails on those rows

- Whether that aborted the start or passed silently came down to sql_mode. With STRICT_TRANS_TABLES, the MariaDB default since 10.2.4, it is an error, without it the value was quietly turned into an empty string and you only got a warning. An older database on a strict server is why this hit some servers and not others

- msk_garage now cleans the column up while the old, looser definition is still in place: NULL and empty values get your Config.DefaultGarage, values longer than 60 characters are shortened to fit, and only then is the column tightened. On a healthy database the cleanup matches no rows and costs nothing. It runs on every start, so a database that breaks later repairs itself
- Moved the vehicle type table from server/vehicles.lua to server/main.lua. Pure reorganisation, the mapping from the type column to the CreateVehicleServerSetter type is unchanged
- No SQL to run by hand, no rebuild and no database change. Replace the files and restart the resource
- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, server/main.lua, server/vehicles.lua]

- Fixed vehicles coming out of the garage and the impound without their tuning: mods, colours, wheels and extras were back to stock while the saved data was fine the whole time. A park-out vehicle is created with CreateVehicleServerSetter, so the entity belongs to the server for the first few hundred milliseconds, and the natives behind ESX.Game.SetVehicleProperties only take effect on the client that owns it. The properties were written in exactly that window and were silently dropped. Whether it worked depended on how fast the ownership migrated, which is why it hit some players and not others

- The script now takes control of the vehicle first and writes the properties afterwards, then reads the values back (colours, wheel type, turbo, every mod slot) and writes them again if something did not stick, for up to a second, because the game keeps normalising a freshly created vehicle for a few more frames. Garage and impound share this code path, both are fixed
- Nothing needs to be repaired in the database, vehicles that used to come out stock have their tuning back with this update. No rebuild, no database change
- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, client/vehicles.lua]

- Fixed admins not being able to open the dashboard even with the group set in the server.cfg. A plain add_principal only makes a player a member of the group, it does not create the matching ace object the check was looking for, and on QBCore the principals are named qbcore.admin instead of group.admin with only qbcore.god linked to group.admin. The script now registers its own ace object per group on start and accepts both spellings, so add_principal ... group.mod and /addpermission 1 mod both work
- Fixed the group check on the Permissions tab reporting 'not found' for brand new groups

- Fixed the 'Access denied for command add_ace' spam on every server start. FiveM checks add_ace against the resource that runs it and no resource holds that right by default, so the ace objects were never actually created. They are registered through msk_core now and the script checks up front whether it is allowed

- Requires msk_core 3.3.0 (MSK.AddRawAce, MSK.CanAddAce). Update msk_core along with this script and make sure your server.cfg has the msk_core ace lines, e.g. add_ace resource.msk_core command.add_ace allow
- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, server/admin/permissions.lua, server/admin/boot.lua, server/admin/api.lua]

- Changed the impound lock for AdvancedParking (Settings > Impounds): instead of reading AdvancedParking's vehicles_parking table, msk_garage now asks AdvancedParking itself through its serverside exports GetVehiclePosition/GetVehiclePositions, the same ones the impound list already uses for the tracking waypoint. In-game behaviour stays exactly the same

- Removed Config.AdvancedParkingTable and Config.AdvancedParkingPlateColumn from config/static.lua, there is no table or column left to configure and a renamed AdvancedParking schema can no longer break the lock
- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, config/settings.lua, config/static.lua, config/garages.lua, config/impounds.lua, shared/utils.lua, server/impound.lua, html/*]

- Added a faction filter to the garage: a toggle next to the favorites filter narrows the park-out list down to the job vehicles of that garage, turning it off shows everything again; the button only appears when there actually are job vehicles

- Added a second-key badge on the vehicle card in the garage and impound: vehicles you only see because you hold a key now show 'Key from <owner name>', or a neutral 'Second key' when the name is hidden or cannot be resolved; the name can be switched off in Settings > Faction vehicles & keys (on by default) and is resolved by the new Utils.GetOwnerName in shared/utils.lua, which you can rewrite for another framework or users table

- Added an option to delete faction vehicles when their owner leaves the job (Settings > Faction vehicles & keys, off by default): every vehicle the player personally owns and that is registered on the job they left is removed for good, hooked to the serverside ESX event esx:setJob; a pure grade change does nothing and society vehicles are never touched
- Added the serverside hook msk_garage:jobVehiclesDeleted(identifier, jobName, plates) in server/handler.lua so you can clean up anything else referencing those plates

- Added Keys.RemoveAllKeys(identifier, plate), which drops the keys of a plate through the adapter of the key script you configured; the jobVehiclesDeleted hook uses it out of the box, so deleted job vehicles no longer leave orphaned keys behind. Implemented for all three supported scripts: msk_vehiclekeys and VehicleKeyChain remove the keys of all players for that plate, vehicles_keys only offers a per-owner remove and therefore leaves second-key holders alone

- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, config/settings.lua, shared/utils.lua, shared/admin_perms.lua, server/main.lua, server/vehicles.lua, server/garages.lua, server/handler.lua, server/keys/*.lua, client/nui.lua, locales/*.lua, html/*]

- Added an optional impound lock for AdvancedParking: with the new toggle in Settings > Impounds a vehicle can only be taken out of the impound once it is gone from the AdvancedParking table (vehicles_parking); blocked vehicles show up greyed out in the impound UI and the impound fee is no longer charged for them
- The toggle is off by default, so nothing changes unless you enable it
- Changed files [fxmanifest.lua, config/settings.lua, config/static.lua, shared/admin_perms.lua, server/impound.lua, server/vehicles.lua, server/garages.lua, client/nui.lua, locales/*.lua, html/*]

- Added luxu_admin support for the admin dashboard: staff groups from luxu_admin v2 (which are not FiveM ACE principals) are now recognized for dashboard access; configurable in config/static.lua via Config.LuxuAdmin (auto / on / off, optional group mapping and an on-duty requirement)
- Fixed heli/aircraft garages staying empty when the vehicle shop stored the type as 'air': 'air' is now accepted as a synonym for the helicopter and aircraft categories
- Added a Job-Garages tab: set per job, via a whitelist or blacklist, which public garages that job's vehicles may be parked in/out at (with select all / deselect all)
- Added UI color customization in Settings > Colors: change the 5 brand colors with live preview and a reset button - applies to the dashboard, garage and impound UI
- Added an editable brand tag: the badge next to the dashboard title (default MSK) can now be changed in Settings > Colors

- Added per-model vehicle images: drop pictures into the vehicle_images folder (named by spawn name) to show real vehicle images instead of the class icon; toggle and format selectable in Settings > Vehicle Images, with automatic fallback to the class icon
- Fixed that job vehicles could be parked into a public garage and become unretrievable - this is now governed by the per-job garage policy
- Added an in-game Admin Dashboard (/garageadmin, command name configurable): create, edit and delete garages & impounds, manage all settings and the permission system - live, without a restart
- Garages, impounds and settings are now stored in the database (seeded once from your config on first start); the config files are only the default template afterwards

- Added a group & permission system: 8 garage/impound rights plus settings and permission management; group.admin always has everything, group.user can never open the dashboard; groups are taken from your server.cfg ACE groups
- Default garages can now be set per category (land / sea / air); deleting a garage reassigns its vehicles to the matching default, and default garages are protected from deletion
- Vehicle key script and target script are now selectable from a dropdown in the dashboard
- AdvancedParking is now detected automatically (removed Config.AdvancedParking)
